items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: It's P. on the boat. You remember? Sean? The P. on the fair had a job on a steamy carpenter.

ctx.x: Huh? Dude and Fostham? Yeah, Dude and Fostham, yeah. I forgot about him, but I met him with Fostham. Then I played with their band a good little while too, Fostham band. And then when they get together, when they pick out their best musicians, you know. And they're taking me, Ivers, and Ivers, uh, Martin. He's there too. He's been there before the drummer. Yeah, uh-huh. And then we went to Kid Island. And I left Kid Island. I played Kid Island about two years. Then I told him come and got me on a job to go to…
Huh? Fats P. Sean? No, not Fats. Steve Lewis? Huh? Steve Lewis? No.
